system.description:
Favoured weapon: Sickle

Granted power: Advantage on Nature checks. Once/day, when your Smite hits, roots burst up around the target: it and each enemy within 10ft of it make a Fortitude save or are Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

Allegiance: Neutral Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Chauntea in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: feed one community through its hardest season (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
